visualReview.notes: Inspected current source, shared-material, medium-fi and retained-terrain renders during this same authoring round. Specific nine-spire Navaratna main shrine with four lower/four upper/one central crown, bowed cornices, cream/red facades, five recessed arch bays, raised platform and south steps; separate southern Natmandir and northern shrine; twelve red double-curved-roof riverfront shrines in two rows around an open passage; low mapped boundary wings. Closed an observed cornice-underside gap, added the missing red panel/frieze rhythm, separated the west shrine row from boundary wings and widened the main-spire review camera. The native broad shell is replaced with an open compound. Unique LOD camera filenames prevent overwritten images. Refined the skyline cornice to retain its bowed silhouette. Unchanged master/source/shared views were carried forward only after checking all other spec/scope fields, master and other-level GLB hashes, camera poses and every retained image hash. The affected level views were captured again.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Three reused 256-square graphs: lime plaster, raw limestone and painted metal. Cream/red roles share the same plaster texture with linear palette tints. Metric UVs, no embedded images or unique atlas, one read per graph, at most four model draws, separate GPU streams and geometry disposal on eviction. Flat/shared stages show buried bases and do not prove terrain contact; the native-grid fixture supplies that check.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 24 current medium-fi views: noon/late, Economy/High, street/block/skyline, silhouette, three details, four explicit levels and transitions. Levels 876 / 3,623 / 12,814 / 30,742 triangles. Initial skyline-plus-district geometry 458,540 bytes. All nine main spires, twelve subordinate shrines and open layout remain at distance; crowns, real recess depth, red panel rhythm and small rails resolve nearer. Physical laptop/phone and dense-city timings remain pending.

The single native compound record is replaced to a boundary residue below 1e-7 square meters; all 408 independent in-tile buildings are byte-identical. Native ground and original Hooghly/pond water geometry stay unchanged. Failed loading restores all 409 original buildings; eviction releases all model geometry. Grass/ground and water classes in the fixture are host context: this model does not repaint the whole court, add the ghat embankment or reconstruct landscaping.
